note: Bought parts (roadmap ROB-01). Every number names the source it was read from. checked is true only when the number was read from the maker's own drawing or datasheet; false means it came from a listing, a general guide or a search excerpt and must be confirmed (or measured) before it is relied on. A number nobody could source is left out, never guessed. Lengths mm, masses g. Frame: the origin is the centre of the hole pattern on the mounting face, +Z points into the part, X and Y along the pattern.
